name: brain-hud
description: Agent memory that works on its own: the mistake-brain skill and its hooks ship inside (log, route, promote, dream, recall), and a pixel Claude with a brain reacts to each MISTAKES.md entry while a pane draws the PARA memory as a graph. Offers finished follow-ups and reached goals to memory. Keeps a session journal (each worker's report, memory entries, finished to-dos, goal steps) that Claude reads through a tool, and drafts a handoff for what the session leaves open.

journal.title: Session journal
journal.description: on keeps a journal of the session (worker reports, memory entries, to-dos done, goal steps) in .claude/brain/, tells Claude beside a prompt when it grew, and gives it a journal tool; off keeps none

handoffDraft.title: Handoff draft at the session's end
handoffDraft.description: on writes a handoff entry to MISTAKES.md when the session ends with something open (a worker's open question, a to-do started and not done, a goal not reached); off writes none
